//: Objective quality agent rubric. Parts must sum to 50 (validated in tests). Each part maps a similarity in [0,1] to points: score = max * clamp((similarity - floor) / (ceiling - floor), 0, 1). Raise 'floor' to stop random images earning points; lower 'ceiling' to make full marks easier. Metrics: dhash (structure, 1 - hamming/64), histogram (color, 1 - chi-square distance over 16-bin RGB histograms), ssim (detail, mean SSIM on 64x64 grayscale), keywords (share of the original prompt's keywords that appear in the player's prompt).
